limitations: This is a three-seed synthetic C1 K=2, box-128, 5-iteration campaign; it does not replace real-data half-map validation or a convergence-to-stopping-criterion study.
RECOVAR did not converge before the cap and final-all-data reconstruction was not forced; final_class maps equal the last numbered half-map averages.
RELION Class3D emits full class maps rather than independent half maps, so masked half-map resolution is outside this synthetic campaign's scope.

The trajectory gate uses direct FSC-AUC, signed per-class GT FSC-AUC delta, and assignment agreement. SCIENCE_EQUIVALENT means every GT-delta cell passes even though a stricter trajectory criterion fails.
Per-class 0.143 GT resolutions come from the independently rigid-aligned endpoint evaluator; final FSC-AUC values come from the frozen trajectory audit.
Peak HBM is a lower bound sampled every five seconds, not an allocator-exact maximum.
External run roots are disposable and carry SAFE_TO_DELETE markers; all source maps consumed by the audit are pinned in per-case checksum manifests.
